thread:
sasha (PM): Heads-up — customer EduGrow asked to bring up Cascade-8B for chat + embeddings. They want private deployment in eu-west and a cost-friendly quantized option. Can we triage?

jamie (ML Eng): OK. Do we have the model weights or a repo link? precision targets?

sasha (PM): They provided a HF link and consented to model evals. Asking for 4-bit quant if possible, latency ~50-80ms p99, and accuracy similar to Llama2-7B baseline on EduGrow QA set.

mohit (Infra): Memory math: Cascade-8B 4-bit should fit on an A10-like node with 40GB if we use grouped-quant & KV cache offload. Need exact tokenizer vocab size. Also: private deployment will require VPC peering and KMS setup.

jamie (ML Eng): Can we get a small reference eval suite from EduGrow? We need prompt templates + golden answers. Also want a baseline run on fp16 to measure regression before quant.

taylor (Tokenizer): I'll verify tokenizer. If it's SentencePiece v0.1.95 and vocab ~32k, it's fine. If they used a custom bpe, we need to patch our TokenizerService.

lia (CS): EduGrow legal ok with model? They signed the data-sharing addendum for evaluation only. They also prefer EU region for inference.

jamie (ML Eng): Proposed triage checklist (quick):
- obtain model artifact + sha256
- run fp16 smoke eval on public benchmark (3k samples)
- run quant (gptq/gfpq) to 4-bit + calib on 2k samples
- compare logits/answers vs fp16 baseline, flag quality regressions >5%
- run perf profile (latency/cost) with synthetic load
- prepare canary deploy + fallback plan

mohit (Infra): Add infra checklist:
- private control plane entitlement + subnet config
- create dedicated nodepool (A10x2)
- ensure kms key usable from customer account
- egress rules for model registry

ci-bot: CI pipeline created: onboarding/cascade-8b/ephemeral-eval #job-8721. Trigger with `/ci trigger onboarding/cascade-8b`

jamie (ML Eng): Quick eval harness snippet (for reproducibility):
```
python eval.py --model hf://edu/cascade-8b --split edu-qa --batch 8 --dtype fp16 --out results/fp16.json
python quant.py --input results/fp16.json --algo gptq --wbits 4 --calib 2048 --out model-4bit.pt
python eval.py --model ./model-4bit.pt --split edu-qa --batch 8 --out results/4bit.json
```

taylor (Tokenizer): Found mismatch: vocab_size differs by 512 tokens from our default. I can add a mapping layer but need owner signoff.

lia (CS): EduGrow prioritized this as P1 for pilot launch next month. They can provide the QA set and ~500 labeled examples for calibration.

jamie (ML Eng): Risks: quant-induced hallucinations on long-context; tokenizer mismatch; perf SLOs in EU region. Mitigations: prefix caching, canary traffic at 5%, and fallback to fp16 host if quality alerts fire.

mohit (Infra): For canary, suggest: 2 instances on dedicated pool, 5% of traffic, auto-roll back when quality regression >4% or latency >120ms. I'll set autoscale min=2,max=6.

sasha (PM): Nice. Owners: jamie -> eval + quant, mohit -> infra & canary config, taylor -> tokenizer fix, lia -> customer data + legal. ETA for first fp16 vs 4-bit perf numbers?

jamie (ML Eng): I can get fp16 baseline + initial 4-bit numbers in 4 business days. Will post results + diff heatmap.

lia (CS): I'll coordinate with EduGrow to drop the QA pack into the secure share today.

mohit (Infra): I'll provision the nodepool tomorrow and wire KMS. Expect infra ready in 48 hours.

sasha (PM): Great — thanks. Action items summarized: (1) jamie: baseline + quant eval (due +4 days), (2) mohit: infra ready + canary config (48h), (3) taylor: tokenizer mapping (48h), (4) lia: dataset drop (today). We'll reconvene in this thread once the fp16 and 4-bit results are posted. :thumbsup:
